notes.title: Major Update! New Levels, Enhanced Graphics, and More!
notes.notes:
[b]A major update has arrived in our game! 🎉[/b] This update brings comprehensive improvements and new features across all areas of the game. Here’s what awaits you in the latest version:

[list]
[*][b]Level Design:[/b] All levels have been redesigned, and a new level has been added to the game.
[*][b]High-Quality Graphics:[/b] The game now utilizes High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP) for a more visually stunning experience.
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] All known bugs have been fixed, providing a smoother experience.
[*][b]Sound Effects:[/b] New sounds have been added, and existing sounds have been improved. A richer atmosphere now awaits you in the game!
[*][b]Character Controls:[/b] Significant improvements have been made to character controls, offering a smoother and more responsive control experience.
[*][b]Chain System:[/b] Enhancements have been made to the chain system, making it more reliable and effective.
[*][b]Optimization:[/b] Game performance has been increased for a faster and smoother gameplay experience.
[*][b]Lobby and Menu Systems:[/b] Extensive changes have been made to the lobby and menu systems, making navigation within the game easier.
[*][b]Settings Panel:[/b] The settings menu has been reorganized to be more user-friendly.
[/list]

We are thrilled to share these updates that will elevate your gaming experience. Have fun! 🎮
